identity_cost.detail: no card: the pricing FAQ describes the 14-day Pro Team trial as 'unlimited reviews and no credit card', so no payment method is taken and no hold exists. The trial starts at signup - 'Every workspace begins with a 14-day free trial starting at signup' - and 'When the trial ends, usage stops unless a paid billing setup is active'. The signup form's own fields are not described, so whether an email, phone number or ID document is required is unknown; kind kept as email without an evidence row stating it.
